Alif Laam Raa. Yeh pur-az-hikmat kitaab ki aayatein hain

Kya logon ke liye yeh baat ajeeb hai ke inhi mein se ek mard par hum yeh wahi naazil kar dein ke logon ko azaab se daraao aur saahibaan-e-imaan ko bashaarat de do ke un ke liye Parwardigar ki baargaah mein buland-tareen darja hai? Magar yeh kaafir kehte hain ke yeh khula hua jaadugar hai

Beshak tumhaara Parwardigar woh hai jis ne zameen o aasmaan ko chhe dinon mein paida kiya hai, phir us ke baad Arsh par apna iqtidaar qaaim kiya hai. Woh tamaam umoor ki tadbeer karne waala hai, koi us ki ijaazat ke baghair shafaa'at karne waala nahin hai. Wahi tumhaara Parwardigar hai, aur usi ki ibaadat karo. Kya tumhein hosh nahin aa raha hai

Usi ki taraf tum sab ki baazgasht hai. Yeh Khuda ka sachcha wa'da hai. Wahi khilqat ka aaghaaz karne waala hai aur waapas le jaane waala hai, taake imaan aur nek amal waalon ko aadilaana jaza de sake, aur jo kaafir ho gaye hain un ke liye to garam paani ka mashroob hai aur un ke kufr ki bina par dardnaak azaab bhi hai

Usi Khuda ne aaftaab ko raushni aur chaand ko noor banaaya hai, phir chaand ki manzilein muqarrar ki hain taake un ke zariye barson ki ta'daad aur doosre hisaabaat daryaaft kar sako. Yeh sab Khuda ne sirf haq ke saath paida kiya hai, ke woh saahibaan-e-ilm ke liye apni aayaton ko tafseel ke saath bayaan karta hai
Beshak din raat ki aamad-o-raft aur jo kuch Khuda ne aasmaan o zameen mein paida kiya hai, un sab mein saahibaan-e-taqwa ke liye us ki nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain
Yaqeenan jo log hamaari mulaaqaat ki ummeed nahin rakhte hain aur zindagaani-e-duniya par hi raazi aur mutma'in ho gaye hain, aur jo log hamaari aayaat se ghaafil hain
Yeh sab woh hain jin ke aamaal ki bina par un ka thikaana Jahannam hai
Beshak jo log imaan laaye aur unhon ne nek aamaal kiye, Khuda un ke imaan ki bina par us manzil ki taraf un ki rehnumaai karega jahaan ne'maton ke baaghaat ke neeche nahrein jaari hongi
Wahaan un ka qaul yeh hoga ke Khudaya! Tu paak aur be-niyaaz hai, aur un ka tohfa salaam hoga, aur un ka aakhri bayaan yeh hoga ke saari ta'reef Khuda-e-Rabb-ul-Aalameen ke liye hai

Agar Khuda logon ke liye buraai mein bhi itni hi jaldi kar deta jitni yeh log bhalaai mein chaahte hain to ab tak un ki muddat ka faisla ho chuka hota. Hum to apni mulaaqaat ki ummeed na rakhne waalon ko un ki sarkashi mein chhod dete hain ke yeh yunhi thokarein khaate phirein

Insaan ko jab koi nuqsaan pahunchta hai to uthte baith-te karwatein badalte hum ko pukaarta hai, aur jab hum us nuqsaan ko door kar dete hain to yun guzar jaata hai jaise kabhi kisi museebat mein hum ko pukaara hi nahin tha. Beshak ziyaadati karne waalon ke aamaal yunhi un ke saamne aaraasta kar diye jaate hain

Yaqeenan hum ne tum se pehle waali ummaton ko halaak kar diya jab unhon ne zulm kiya, aur hamaare paighambar hamaari nishaaniyaan le kar aaye to woh imaan na la sake. Hum isi tarah mujrim qaum ko saza dete hain
Us ke baad hum ne tum ko roo-e-zameen par un ka jaanasheen bana diya taake dekhein ke ab tum kaise aamaal karte ho

Aur jab un ke saamne hamaari aayaat ki tilaawat ki jaati hai to jin logon ko hamaari mulaaqaat ki ummeed nahin hai woh kehte hain ke is ke ilaawa koi doosra Quran laaiye ya isi ko badal dijiye. To aap keh dijiye ke mujhe apni taraf se badalne ka koi ikhtiyaar nahin hai, main to sirf us amr ka ittibaa' karta hoon jis ki meri taraf wahi ki jaati hai. Main apne Parwardigar ki naafarmaani karoon to mujhe ek bade azeem din ke azaab ka khauf hai

Aap keh dijiye ke agar Khuda chaahta to main tumhaare saamne tilaawat na karta aur tumhein is ki ittilaa' bhi na karta. Aakhir main is se pehle bhi tumhaare darmiyaan ek muddat tak reh chuka hoon, to kya tumhaare paas itni aql bhi nahin hai
Us se bada zaalim kaun hai jo Allah par jhoota ilzaam lagaaye ya us ki aayaton ki takzeeb kare, jab ke woh mujrimeen ko najaat dene waala nahin hai

Aur yeh log Khuda ko chhod kar un ki parastish karte hain jo na nuqsaan pahuncha sakte hain aur na faaida, aur yeh log kehte hain ke yeh Khuda ke yahaan hamaari sifaarish karne waale hain. To aap keh dijiye ke tum to Khuda ko us baat ki ittilaa' kar rahe ho jis ka ilm use aasmaan o zameen mein kaheen nahin hai. Woh paak o paakeeza hai aur un ke shirk se buland o bartar hai

Saare insaan fitratan ek ummat the, phir sab aapas mein alag alag ho gaye, aur agar tumhaare Rab ki baat pehle se tai na ho chuki hoti to yeh jis baat mein ikhtilaaf karte hain us ka faisla ho chuka hota

Yeh log kehte hain ke Khuda ki taraf se un par koi nishaani kyon nahin naazil hoti? To aap keh dijiye ke tamaam ghaib ka ikhtiyaar Parwardigar ko hai, aur tum intizaar karo aur main bhi tumhaare saath intizaar karne waalon mein hoon

Aur jab takleef pahunchne ke baad hum ne logon ko zara rehmat ka maza chakha diya to fauran hamaari aayaton mein makkaari karne lage. To aap keh dijiye ke Khuda tum se tez-tar tadbeerein karne waala hai, aur hamaare numaainde tumhaare makr ko baraabar likh rahe hain

Woh Khuda woh hai jo tumhein khushki aur samandar mein sair karaata hai, yahaan tak ke jab tum kashti mein the aur paakeeza hawaayein chalin aur saare musaafir khush ho gaye, to achaanak ek tez hawa chal gayi aur maujon ne har taraf se ghere mein le liya aur yeh khayaal paida ho gaya ke chaaron taraf se ghir gaye hain, to deen-e-khaalis ke saath Allah se dua karne lage ke agar is museebat se najaat mil gayi to hum yaqeenan shukr-guzaaron mein ho jaayenge

Us ke baad jab us ne najaat de di to zameen mein naahaq zulm karne lage. Insaano! Yaad rakho tumhaara zulm tumhaare hi khilaaf hoga. Yeh sirf chand-roza zindagi ka maza hai, us ke baad tum sab ki baazgasht hamaari hi taraf hogi aur phir hum tumhein bataayenge ke tum duniya mein kya kar rahe the

Zindagaani-e-duniya ki misaal sirf us baarish ki hai jise hum ne aasmaan se naazil kiya, phir us se mil kar zameen se woh nabaataat baraamad hueen jin ko insaan aur jaanwar khaate hain, yahaan tak ke jab zameen ne sabza-zaar se apne ko aaraasta kar liya aur maalikon ne khayaal karna shuroo kar diya ke ab hum is zameen ke saahib-e-ikhtiyaar hain, to achaanak hamaara hukm raat ya din ke waqt aa gaya aur hum ne use bilkul kata hua khet bana diya, goya is mein kal kuch tha hi nahin. Hum isi tarah apni aayaton ko mufassal tareeqe se bayaan karte hain us qaum ke liye jo saahib-e-fikr o nazar hai
Allah har ek ko salaamati ke ghar ki taraf daawat deta hai aur jise chaahta hai seedhe raaste ki hidaayat de deta hai
Jin logon ne neki ki hai un ke waaste neki bhi hai aur izaafa bhi, aur un ke chehron par na siyaahi hogi aur na zillat. Woh jannat waale hain aur wahin hamesha rehne waale hain

Aur jin logon ne buraaiyaan kamaayi hain un ke liye har buraai ke badle waisi hi buraai hai, aur un ke chehron par gunaahon ki siyaahi bhi hogi, aur inhein azaab-e-Ilaahi se bachaane waala koi na hoga. Un ke chehre par jaise siyaah raat ki taareeki ka parda daal diya gaya ho. Woh ahl-e-Jahannam hain aur usi mein hamesha rehne waale hain

Jis din hum sab ko ikattha jama karenge aur us ke baad shirk karne waalon se kahenge ke tum aur tumhaare shurakaa sab apni apni jagah thehro, aur phir hum un ke darmiyaan judaai daal denge, aur un ke shurakaa kahenge ke tum hamaari ibaadat to nahin karte the
Ab Khuda hamaare aur tumhaare darmiyaan gawaahi ke liye kaafi hai ke hum tumhaari ibaadat se bilkul ghaafil the

Us waqt har shakhs apne guzishta aamaal ka imtehaan karega aur sab Maula-e-barhaq Khudawand-e-Ta'ala ki baargaah mein palta diye jaayenge, aur jo kuch iftira kar rahe the woh sab bhatak kar gum ho jaaega

Paighambar! Zara un se poochhiye ke tumhein zameen o aasmaan se kaun rizq deta hai, aur kaun tumhaari samaa'at o basaarat ka maalik hai, aur kaun murda se zinda aur zinda se murda ko nikaalta hai, aur kaun saare umoor ki tadbeer karta hai? To yeh sab yahi kahenge ke Allah! To aap kahiye ke phir us se kyon nahin darte ho
Wahi Allah tumhaara barhaq paalne waala hai, aur haq ke baad zalaalat ke siwa kuch nahin hai, to tum kis tarah le jaaye ja rahe ho
Isi tarah Khuda ka azaab faasiqon ke haq mein saabit ho gaya ke woh imaan laane waale nahin hain

Aap zara poochhiye ke kya tumhaare shareekon mein koi hai jo khilqat ki ibtida kare aur phir dobaara use palta sake? Aur phir bataaiye ke Allah hi makhlooqaat ki ibtida karta hai aur wahi inhein palataata bhi hai, to tum aakhir kidhar chale ja rahe ho

Kahiye ke kya tumhaare shurakaa mein koi aisa hai jo haq ki hidaayat kar sake? Aur phir bataaiye ke Allah hi haq ki hidaayat karta hai. Aur jo haq ki hidaayat karta hai woh waaqe'an qaabil-e-ittibaa' hai ya jo hidaayat karne ke qaabil bhi nahin hai magar yeh ke khud us ki hidaayat ki jaaye? To aakhir tumhein kya ho gaya hai aur tum kaise faisle kar rahe ho
Aur un ki aksariyat to sirf khayaalaat ka ittibaa' karti hai, jab ke gumaan haq ke baare mein koi faaida nahin pahuncha sakta. Beshak Allah un ke aamaal se khoob waaqif hai

Aur yeh Quran kisi ghair-e-Khuda ki taraf se iftira nahin hai balke apne maa-sabaq ki kitaabon ki tasdeeq aur tafseel hai jis mein kisi shak ki gunjaaish nahin hai, yeh Rabb-ul-Aalameen ka naazil-karda hai

Kya yeh log yeh kehte hain ke ise Paighambar ne gadh liya hai? To keh dijiye ke tum is ke jaisa ek hi soorah le aao, aur Khuda ke ilaawa jise chaaho apni madad ke liye bula lo, agar tum apne ilzaam mein sachche ho

Dar-haqeeqat un logon ne us cheez ki takzeeb ki hai jis ka mukammal ilm bhi nahin hai aur us ki taaweel bhi un ke paas nahin aayi hai. Isi tarah un se pehle waalon ne bhi takzeeb ki thi, ab dekho ke zulm karne waalon ka anjaam kya hota hai
Un mein ba'z woh hain jo is par imaan laate hain aur ba'z nahin maante hain, aur aap ka Parwardigar fasaad karne waalon ko khoob jaanta hai
Aur agar yeh aap ki takzeeb karein to keh dijiye ke mere liye mera amal hai aur tumhaare liye tumhaara amal hai. Tum mere amal se bari aur main tumhaare aamaal se bezaar hoon
Aur un mein se ba'z aise bhi hain jo ba-zaahir kaan laga kar sunte bhi hain, lekin kya aap behron ko baat sunaana chaahte hain jab ke woh samajhte bhi nahin hain
Aur un mein kuch hain jo aap ki taraf dekh rahe hain, to kya aap andhon ko bhi hidaayat de sakte hain chaahe woh kuch na dekh paate hon
Allah insaanon par zarra baraabar zulm nahin karta hai balke insaan khud hi apne oopar zulm kiya karte hain

Jis din Khuda un sab ko mahshoor karega is tarah ke jaise duniya mein sirf ek saa'at thehre hon, aur woh aapas mein ek doosre ko pehchaante honge. Yaqeenan jin logon ne Khuda ki mulaaqaat ka inkaar kiya hai woh khasaare mein rahe aur hidaayat-yaafta nahin ho sake

Aur hum ne jin baaton ka un se wa'da kiya hai inhein aap ko dikha dein ya aap ko pehle hi duniya se utha lein, inhein to bahar-haal palat kar hamaari hi baargaah mein aana hai, us ke baad Khuda khud un ke aamaal ka gawaah hai
Aur har ummat ke liye ek rasool hai, aur jab rasool aa jaata hai to un ke darmiyaan aadilaana faisla ho jaata hai aur un par kisi tarah ka zulm nahin hota hai
Yeh log kehte hain ke agar aap sachche hain to yeh wa'da-e-azaab kab poora hoga

Keh dijiye ke main apne nafs ke nuqsaan o nafa ka bhi maalik nahin hoon jab tak Khuda na chaahe. Har qaum ke liye ek muddat mu'ayyan hai jis se ek saa'at ki bhi na taakheer ho sakti hai aur na taqdeem
Keh dijiye ke tumhaara kya khayaal hai, agar us ka azaab raat ke waqt ya din mein aa jaaye to tum kya karoge? Aakhir yeh mujrimeen kis baat ki jaldi kar rahe hain
To kya tum azaab ke naazil hone ke baad imaan laaoge? Aur kya ab imaan laaoge jab ke tum azaab ki jaldi machaaye hue the
Us ke baad zaalimeen se kaha jaaega ke ab hameshgi ka maza chakho. Kya tumhaare aamaal ke ilaawa kisi aur cheez ka badla diya jaaega
Yeh aap se daryaaft karte hain kya yeh azaab barhaq hai? To farma dijiye ke haan beshak barhaq hai, aur tum Khuda ko aajiz nahin bana sakte

Agar har zulm karne waale nafs ko saari zameen ke khazeene mil jaayein to woh us din ke azaab ke badle de dega, aur azaab ke dekhne ke baad andar andar naadim bhi hoga, lekin un ke darmiyaan insaaf ke saath faisla kar diya jaaega aur un par kisi tarah ka zulm na kiya jaaega
Yaad rakho ke Khuda hi ke liye zameen o aasmaan ke kul khazaane hain, aur aagaah ho jaao ke Khuda ka wa'da barhaq hai, agarche logon ki aksariyat nahin samajhti hai
Wahi Khuda hayaat o maut ka dene waala hai, aur usi ki taraf tum sab ko palta kar le jaaya jaaega
Ayyuhan-naas! Tumhaare paas Parwardigar ki taraf se naseehat aur dilon ki shifa ka saamaan aur hidaayat aur saahibaan-e-imaan ke liye rehmat, Quran aa chuka hai
Paighambar! Keh dijiye ke yeh Quran fazl o rehmat-e-Khuda ka nateeja hai, lihaaza inhein is par khush hona chaahiye ke yeh un ke jama kiye hue amwaal se kaheen ziyaada behtar hai

Aap keh dijiye ke Khuda ne tumhaare liye rizq naazil kiya to tum ne us mein bhi halaal o haraam banaana shuroo kar diya. To kya Khuda ne tumhein is ki ijaazat di hai ya tum Khuda par iftira kar rahe ho
Aur jo log Khuda par jhoota ilzaam lagaate hain un ka roz-e-qiyaamat ke baare mein kya khayaal hai? Allah insaanon par fazl karne waala hai lekin un ki aksariyat shukr karne waali nahin hai

Aur Paighambar! Aap kisi haal mein rahein aur Quran ke kisi hisse ki tilaawat karein, aur ae logo! Tum koi amal karo, hum tum sab ke gawaah hote hain jab bhi koi amal karte ho, aur tumhaare Parwardigar se zameen o aasmaan ka koi zarra door nahin hai, aur koi shai zarre se badi ya chhoti aisi nahin hai jise hum ne apni khuli kitaab mein jama na kar diya ho
Aagaah ho jaao ke auliya-e-Khuda par na khauf taari hota hai aur na woh mahzoon aur ranjeeda hote hain
Yeh woh log hain jo imaan laaye aur Khuda se darte rahe
Un ke liye zindagaani-e-duniya aur aakhirat donon maqaamaat par bashaarat aur khushkhabri hai, aur kalimaat-e-Khuda mein koi tabdeeli nahin ho sakti hai, aur yahi dar-haqeeqat azeem kaamyaabi hai
Paighambar! Aap un logon ki baaton se ranjeeda na hon. Izzat sab ki sab sirf Allah ke liye hai, wahi sab kuch sunne waala hai aur jaanne waala hai

Aagaah ho jaao ke Allah hi ke liye zameen o aasmaan ki saari makhlooqaat aur kaainaat hai, aur jo log Khuda ko chhod kar doosre shareekon ko pukaarte hain woh un ka bhi ittibaa' nahin karte. Yeh sirf apne khayaalaat ka ittibaa' karte hain aur yeh sirf andaazon par zindagi guzaar rahe hain

Woh Khuda woh hai jis ne tumhaare liye raat banaayi hai taake us mein sukoon haasil kar sako, aur din ko raushni ka zariya banaaya hai, aur is mein bhi baat sunne waali qaum ke liye nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain

Yeh log kehte hain ke Allah ne apna koi beta banaaya hai, haalaanke woh paak o be-niyaaz hai aur us ke liye zameen o aasmaan ki saari kaainaat hai. Tumhaare paas to tumhaari baat ki koi daleel bhi nahin hai. Kya tum log Khuda par woh ilzaam lagaate ho jis ka tumhein ilm bhi nahin hai
Paighambar! Aap keh dijiye ke jo log Khuda par jhoota ilzaam lagaate hain woh kabhi kaamyaab nahin ho sakte
Is duniya mein thoda sa aaraam hai, us ke baad sab ki baazgasht hamaari hi taraf hai, us ke baad hum un ke kufr ki bina par inhein shadeed azaab ka maza chakhaayenge

Aap in kuffaar ke saamne Nooh ka waaqe'a bayaan karein ke unhon ne apni qaum se kaha ke agar tumhaare liye mera qiyaam aur aayaat-e-Ilaahiya ka yaad dilaana sakht hai to mera e'temaad Allah par hai. Tum bhi apna iraada pukhta kar lo aur apne shareekon ko bula lo, aur tumhaari koi baat tumhaare oopar makhfi bhi na rahe, phir jo jee chaahe kar guzro aur mujhe kisi tarah ki mohlat na do
Phir agar tum inhiraaf karoge to main tum se koi ajr bhi nahin chaahta, mera ajr to sirf Allah ke zimme hai, aur mujhe hukm diya gaya hai ke main us ke itaa'at-guzaaron mein shaamil rahoon

Phir qaum ne un ki takzeeb ki to hum ne Nooh aur un ke saathiyon ko kashti mein najaat de di aur inhein zameen ka waaris bana diya, aur apni aayaat ki takzeeb karne waalon ko dubo diya. To ab dekhiye ke jin ko daraaya jaata hai un ke na maanne ka anjaam kya hota hai

Us ke baad hum ne mukhtalif rasool un ki qaumon ki taraf bheje aur woh un ke paas khuli hui nishaaniyaan le kar aaye, lekin woh log pehle ke inkaar karne ki bina par un ki tasdeeq na kar sake, aur hum isi tarah zaalimon ke dil par mohr laga dete hain
Phir hum ne un rasoolon ke baad Fir'aun aur us ki jamaa'at ki taraf Moosa aur Haaroon ko apni nishaaniyaan de kar bheja, to un logon ne bhi inkaar kar diya aur woh sab bhi mujrim log the
Phir jab Moosa un ke paas hamaari taraf se haq le kar aaye to unhon ne kaha ke yeh to khula hua jaadu hai
Moosa ne jawaab diya ke tum log haq ke aane ke baad use jaadu keh rahe ho? Kya yeh tumhaare nazdeek jaadu hai, jab ke jaadugar kabhi kaamyaab nahin hote

Un logon ne kaha tum yeh paighaam is liye laaye ho ke humein baap daada ke raaste se munharif kar do aur tum donon ko zameen mein hukoomat o iqtidaar mil jaaye, aur hum hargiz tumhaari baat maanne waale nahin hain
Aur Fir'aun ne kaha ke tamaam hoshiyaar maahir jaadugaron ko mere paas haazir karo
Phir jab jaadugar aa gaye to Moosa ne un se kaha jo jo kuch phenkna chaahte ho phenko
Phir jab un logon ne rassiyon ko daal diya to Moosa ne kaha ke jo kuch tum le aaye ho yeh jaadu hai aur Allah is ko bekaar kar dega, woh mufsideen ke amal ko durust nahin hone deta hai
Apne kalimaat ke zariye haq ko saabit kar deta hai, chaahe mujrimeen ko kitna hi bura kyon na lage

Phir bhi Moosa par imaan na laaye magar un ki qaum ki ek nasl, aur woh bhi Fir'aun aur us ki jamaa'at ke khauf ke saath ke kaheen woh kisi aazmaaish mein na mubtala kar de, ke Fir'aun bahut ooncha hai aur woh israaf aur ziyaadati karne waala bhi hai
Aur Moosa ne apni qaum se kaha ke agar tum waaqe'an Allah par imaan laaye ho to usi par bharosa karo, agar waaqe'an us ke itaa'at-guzaar bande ho
To un logon ne kaha ke beshak hum ne Khuda par bharosa kiya hai. Khudaya! Humein zaalimon ke fitnon aur aazmaaishon ka markaz na qaraar dena
Aur apni rehmat ke zariye kaafir qaum ke shar se mahfooz rakhna
Aur hum ne Moosa aur un ke bhaai ki taraf wahi ki ke apni qaum ke liye Misr mein ghar banaao aur apne gharon ko qibla qaraar do aur namaaz qaaim karo aur momineen ko bashaarat de do

Aur Moosa ne kaha ke Parwardigar! Tu ne Fir'aun aur us ke saathiyon ko zindagaani-e-duniya mein amwaal ata kiye hain. Khudaya! Yeh tere raaste se behkaayenge. Khudaya! Un ke amwaal ko barbaad kar de, un ke dilon par sakhti naazil farma. Yeh us waqt tak imaan na laayenge jab tak apni aankhon se dardnaak azaab na dekh lein
Parwardigar ne farmaaya ke tum donon ki dua qubool kar li gayi, to ab apne raaste par qaaim rehna aur jaahilon ke raaste ka ittibaa' na karna

Aur hum ne Bani Israaeel ko darya paar kara diya to Fir'aun aur us ke lashkar ne az-raah-e-zulm o ta'addi un ka peechha kiya, yahaan tak ke jab gharqaabi ne use pakad liya to us ne aawaaz di ke main us Khuda-e-Wahdahu La Shareek par imaan le aaya hoon jis par Bani Israaeel imaan laaye hain aur main itaa'at-guzaaron mein hoon
To aawaaz aayi ke ab? Jab ke tu pehle naafarmaani kar chuka hai aur tera shumaar mufsidon mein ho chuka hai
Khair, aaj hum tere badan ko bacha lete hain taake tu apne baad waalon ke liye nishaani ban jaaye, agarche bahut se log hamaari nishaaniyon se ghaafil hi rehte hain

Aur hum ne Bani Israaeel ko behtareen manzil ata ki hai aur inhein paakeeza rizq ata kiya hai, to un logon ne aapas mein ikhtilaaf nahin kiya yahaan tak ke un ke paas Taurait aa gayi. To ab Khuda un ke darmiyaan roz-e-qiyaamat un ke ikhtilaafaat ka faisla kar dega

Ab agar tum ko us mein shak hai jo hum ne naazil kiya hai to un logon se poochho jo us se pehle kitaab-e-Taurait o Injeel padhte rahe hain. Yaqeenan tumhaare Parwardigar ki taraf se haq aa chuka hai, to ab tum shak karne waalon mein shaamil na ho
Aur un logon mein na ho jaao jinhon ne aayaat-e-Ilaahiya ki takzeeb ki hai, ke is tarah khasaare waalon mein shumaar ho jaaoge
Beshak jin logon par kalima-e-azaab-e-Ilaahi saabit ho chuka hai woh hargiz imaan laane waale nahin hain
Chaahe un ke paas tamaam nishaaniyaan kyon na aa jaayein, jab tak apni aankhon se dardnaak azaab na dekh lenge

Pas koi basti aisi kyon nahin hai jo imaan le aaye aur us ka imaan use faaida pahunchaaye, ilaawa qaum-e-Yunus ke ke jab woh imaan le aaye to hum ne un se zindagaani-e-duniya mein ruswaai ka azaab daf'a kar diya aur inhein ek muddat tak chain se rehne diya
Aur agar Khuda chaahta to roo-e-zameen par rehne waale sab imaan le aate. To kya aap logon par jabr karenge ke sab momin ban jaayein
Aur kisi nafs ke imkaan mein nahin hai ke baghair ijaazat o taufeeq-e-Parwardigar ke imaan le aaye, aur woh un logon par khabaasat ko laazim qaraar de deta hai jo aql isti'maal nahin karte hain
Paighambar! Keh dijiye ke zara aasmaan o zameen mein ghaur o fikr karo, aur yaad rakhiye ke jo imaan laane waale nahin hain un ke haq mein nishaaniyaan aur daraawe kuch kaam aane waale nahin hain
Ab kya yeh log unhi bure dinon ka intizaar kar rahe hain jo un se pehle waalon par guzar chuke hain? To keh dijiye ke phir intizaar karo, main bhi tumhaare saath intizaar karne waalon mein hoon
Us ke baad hum apne rasoolon aur imaan waalon ko najaat dete hain, aur yeh hamaare oopar ek haq hai ke hum saahibaan-e-imaan ko najaat dilaayein

Paighambar! Aap keh dijiye ke agar tum logon ko mere deen mein shak hai to main un ki parastish nahin kar sakta jinhein tum log Khuda ko chhod kar pooj rahe ho. Main to sirf us Khuda ki ibaadat karta hoon jo tum sab ko maut dene waala hai, aur mujhe hukm diya gaya hai ke main saahibaan-e-imaan mein shaamil rahoon
Aur aap apna rukh bilkul deen ki taraf rakhein, baatil se alag rahein aur hargiz mushrikeen ki jamaa'at mein shumaar na hon
Aur Khuda ke ilaawa kisi aise ko aawaaz na dein jo na faaida pahuncha sakta hai aur na nuqsaan, warna aisa karenge to aap ka shumaar bhi zaalimeen mein ho jaaega

Aur agar Khuda nuqsaan pahunchaana chaahe to us ke ilaawa koi bachaane waala nahin hai, aur agar woh bhalaai ka iraada kar le to us ke fazl ka koi rokne waala nahin hai. Woh jis ko chaahta hai apne bandon mein bhalaai ata karta hai, woh bada bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai

Paighambar! Aap keh dijiye ke tumhaare paas Parwardigar ki taraf se haq aa chuka hai. Ab jo hidaayat haasil karega woh apne faaide ke liye karega, aur jo gumraah ho jaaega us ka nuqsaan bhi usi ko hoga, aur main tumhaara zimmedaar nahin hoon
Aur aap sirf us baat ka ittibaa' karein jis ki aap ki taraf wahi ki jaati hai, aur sabr karte rahein yahaan tak ke Khuda koi faisla kar de, aur woh behtareen faisla karne waala hai
